title: PURSUE Release 3 - official record index (all 72 records: documents, videos, images, audio)
doc_notes: This document is an official index of 72 records released by the Department of War, containing several reports of close-range UAP encounters.

encounters.summary: A U.S. military service member reported a motionless, bean-shaped object with a surface of intersecting ridges near Colorado Springs.
encounters.quote: bean shaped, matte white or off-white in color

encounters.summary: Two eyewitnesses observed two identical red spheres with white plasma centers hovering and moving in tandem before merging.
